#!/bin/sh
set -eu

root=${API_RUN_ROOT:-/tmp/libtmux-java-dev}

# socket under TMUX_TMPDIR. The program gets none of them, and a TMUX_TMPDIR of its own below.
unset TMUX TMUX_PANE
for name in $(env | sed -n 's/^\(LIBTMUX_SOCKET[A-Za-z0-9_]*\)=.*/\1/p'); do
    unset "$name"
done

mkdir -p "$root"
directory=$(mktemp -d "$root/api.XXXXXX")
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d "$root/tmpdir.XXXXXX")
socket="$directory/tmux.sock"
config="$directory/tmux.conf"

serves() {
    "$binary" -S "$1" display-message -p '#{pid}' >/dev/null 2>&1
}

stop() {
    "$binary" -S "$1" kill-server || return 1
    attempts=0
    while serves "$1" && [ "$attempts" -lt 60 ]; do
        sleep 0.05
        attempts=$((attempts + 1))
    done
    ! serves "$1"

    status=$?
    trap - 0 HUP INT TERM PIPE

    trap '' PIPE

    stuck=

    if [ -S "$socket" ] && serves "$socket" && ! stop "$socket"; then

(ns libtmux.examples.api.workspace
  "Build a layout, rename a window, and follow its new placement after a move."
  (:require [libtmux.core :as tm]
            [libtmux.data :as data]))

(defn -main [& args]
  (when-not (= 3 (count args))
    (throw (IllegalArgumentException. "expected: tmux-binary socket-path config-file")))
  (let [[binary socket config] args]
    (with-open [server (tm/open! {:binary binary :socket-path socket
                                 :config-file config})]
      (let [source (tm/new-session! server {:name "workspace" :window-name "editor"
                                           :command ["/bin/cat"]})
            editor (data/exactly-one (data/windows source))
            pane (data/exactly-one (data/panes editor))
            destination (tm/new-session! server {:name "destination" :command ["/bin/cat"]})]
        (tm/new-window! (:tmux/ref source) {:name "logs" :detached? true :command ["/bin/cat"]})
        (tm/split-pane! (:tmux/ref pane) {:direction :right :percent 40 :command ["/bin/cat"]})
        (let [layout (:window/layout (tm/refresh! (:tmux/ref editor)))]
          (tm/apply-layout! (:tmux/ref editor) layout))
        (let [renamed (tm/rename! (:tmux/ref editor) "code")]
          (assert (= "editor" (:window/name editor)))
          (assert (= "code" (:window/name renamed)))
          (tm/move-window! (:tmux/ref renamed) (:tmux/ref destination) 5))
        (let [moved (data/exactly-one
                     (filter #(= (:window/id editor) (:window/id %)) (tm/windows! server)))]
          (assert (data/same-entity? editor moved))
          (assert (not (data/same-link? editor moved)))
          (assert (= (:session/id destination) (get-in moved [:tmux/link :session/id])))
          (assert (= 5 (:window/index moved)))
          (assert (= 2 (count (data/panes moved))))
          (println (str "window=" (:window/name moved) " panes=" (count (data/panes moved))))
          (println "same-entity=true same-placement=false"))))))

(ns libtmux.examples.api.capture-concurrently
  "Capture on bounded workers and cancel an explicitly classified wait."
  (:require [libtmux.async :as async]
            [libtmux.core :as tm])
  (:import [java.lang AutoCloseable]
           [java.time Duration]
           [java.util.concurrent CountDownLatch TimeUnit]))

(defn -main [& args]
  (when-not (= 3 (count args))
    (throw (IllegalArgumentException. "expected: tmux-binary socket-path config-file")))
  (let [[binary socket config] args]
    (with-open [server (tm/open! {:binary binary :socket-path socket :config-file config})
                ^AutoCloseable runtime (async/runtime! {:max-running 4 :queue-limit 4})]
      (let [panes (take 3 (tm/panes! server))
            tasks (mapv #(async/submit! runtime (fn [] (tm/capture! (:tmux/ref %)))) panes)
            captures (mapv deref tasks)
            started (CountDownLatch. 1)
            cleaned (promise)
            waiting (async/submit! runtime {:kind :wait}
                                   #(try
                                      (.countDown started)
                                      (tm/await-channel! server "example-cancel" (Duration/ofMillis 900))
                                      (finally (deliver cleaned true))))]
        (assert (= 3 (count captures)))
        (assert (every? vector? captures))
        (assert (.await started 900 TimeUnit/MILLISECONDS))
        (async/cancel! waiting)
        (let [failure (try @waiting nil (catch clojure.lang.ExceptionInfo error error))]
          (assert (= :cancelled (:tmux/error (ex-data failure))))
          (assert (realized? cleaned)))
        (println (str "captured=" (count captures)))
        (println "cancelled=true cleaned=true")))))

(ns libtmux.examples.api.capture
  "Send literal shell input, wait for its output, and verify captured lines."
  (:require [clojure.string :as str]
            [libtmux.core :as tm]
            [libtmux.data :as data])
  (:import [java.time Duration]))

(defn -main [& args]
  (when-not (= 3 (count args))
    (throw (IllegalArgumentException. "expected: tmux-binary socket-path config-file")))
  (let [[binary socket config] args]
    (with-open [server (tm/open! {:binary binary :socket-path socket
                                 :config-file config})]
      (let [session (tm/new-session! server {:name "api-capture" :command ["/bin/sh"]})
            pane (:tmux/ref (data/exactly-one (data/panes session)))]
        (doseq [word ["keys" "line"]]
          (tm/send-literal! pane (str "printf 'api-%s\\n' " word))
          (tm/send-keys! pane ["Enter"])
          (when-not (#{:appeared :present-at-entry}
                     (tm/await-text! pane (str "api-" word) (Duration/ofMillis 900)))
            (throw (IllegalStateException. "shell output did not arrive"))))
        (let [lines (set (map str/trim (tm/capture! pane)))]
          (doseq [expected ["api-keys" "api-line"]]
            (assert (contains? lines expected) (str "capture is missing " expected))
            (println expected)))))))

(ns libtmux.examples.api.capture-concurrently
  "Capture on bounded workers and cancel an explicitly classified wait."
  (:require [libtmux.async :as async]
            [libtmux.core :as tm])
  (:import [java.lang AutoCloseable]
           [java.time Duration]
           [java.util.concurrent CountDownLatch TimeUnit]))

(defn -main [& args]
  (when-not (= 3 (count args))
    (throw (IllegalArgumentException. "expected: tmux-binary socket-path config-file")))
  (let [[binary socket config] args]
    (with-open [server (tm/open! {:binary binary :socket-path socket :config-file config})
                ^AutoCloseable runtime (async/runtime! {:max-running 4 :queue-limit 4})]
      (let [panes (take 3 (tm/panes! server))
            tasks (mapv #(async/submit! runtime (fn [] (tm/capture! (:tmux/ref %)))) panes)
            captures (mapv deref tasks)
            started (CountDownLatch. 1)
            cleaned (promise)
            waiting (async/submit! runtime {:kind :wait}
                                   #(try
                                      (.countDown started)
                                      (tm/await-channel! server "example-cancel" (Duration/ofMillis 900))
                                      (finally (deliver cleaned true))))]
        (assert (= 3 (count captures)))
        (assert (every? vector? captures))
        (assert (.await started 900 TimeUnit/MILLISECONDS))
        (async/cancel! waiting)
        (let [failure (try @waiting nil (catch clojure.lang.ExceptionInfo error error))]
          (assert (= :cancelled (:tmux/error (ex-data failure))))
          (assert (realized? cleaned)))
        (println (str "captured=" (count captures)))
        (println "cancelled=true cleaned=true")))))

                                 :config-file config})]
      (let [source (tm/new-session! server {:name "workspace" :window-name "editor"
                                           :command ["/bin/cat"]})
            editor (data/exactly-one (data/windows source))
            pane (data/exactly-one (data/panes editor))
            destination (tm/new-session! server {:name "destination" :command ["/bin/cat"]})]
        (tm/new-window! (:tmux/ref source) {:name "logs" :detached? true :command ["/bin/cat"]})
        (tm/split-pane! (:tmux/ref pane) {:direction :right :percent 40 :command ["/bin/cat"]})
        (let [layout (:window/layout (tm/refresh! (:tmux/ref editor)))]
          (tm/apply-layout! (:tmux/ref editor) layout))
        (let [renamed (tm/rename! (:tmux/ref editor) "code")]
          (assert (= "editor" (:window/name editor)))
          (assert (= "code" (:window/name renamed)))

          (assert (data/same-entity? editor moved))
          (assert (not (data/same-link? editor moved)))
          (assert (= (:session/id destination) (get-in moved [:tmux/link :session/id])))
          (assert (= 5 (:window/index moved)))
          (assert (= 2 (count (data/panes moved))))
          (println (str "window=" (:window/name moved) " panes=" (count (data/panes moved))))

                                           :command ["/bin/cat"]})

            pane (data/exactly-one (data/panes editor))
            destination (tm/new-session! server {:name "destination" :command ["/bin/cat"]})]

        (tm/split-pane! (:tmux/ref pane) {:direction :right :percent 40 :command ["/bin/cat"]})

          (tm/apply-layout! (:tmux/ref editor) layout))
        (let [renamed (tm/rename! (:tmux/ref editor) "code")]
          (assert (= "editor" (:window/name editor)))
          (assert (= "code" (:window/name renamed)))

          (assert (data/same-entity? editor moved))
          (assert (not (data/same-link? editor moved)))
          (assert (= (:session/id destination) (get-in moved [:tmux/link :session/id])))
          (assert (= 5 (:window/index moved)))
          (assert (= 2 (count (data/panes moved))))
          (println (str "window=" (:window/name moved) " panes=" (count (data/panes moved))))
          (println "same-entity=true same-placement=false"))))))

(ns libtmux.examples.api.capture
  "Send literal shell input, wait for its output, and verify captured lines."
  (:require [clojure.string :as str]
            [libtmux.core :as tm]
            [libtmux.data :as data])
  (:import [java.time Duration]))

          (tm/send-keys! pane ["Enter"])
          (when-not (#{:appeared :present-at-entry}
                     (tm/await-text! pane (str "api-" word) (Duration/ofMillis 900)))

#!/bin/sh
set -eu

if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then
    printf 'Usage: sh run.sh program [arguments...]\n' >&2
    exit 2
fi
binary=$(command -v "${TMUX_BIN:-tmux}")
root=${API_RUN_ROOT:-/tmp/libtmux-java-dev}

# A client that names no socket follows TMUX or LIBTMUX_SOCKET*, and otherwise lands on the default
# socket under TMUX_TMPDIR. The program gets none of them, and a TMUX_TMPDIR of its own below.
unset TMUX TMUX_PANE
for name in $(env | sed -n 's/^\(LIBTMUX_SOCKET[A-Za-z0-9_]*\)=.*/\1/p'); do
    unset "$name"
done

mkdir -p "$root"
directory=$(mktemp -d "$root/api.XXXXXX")
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d "$root/tmpdir.XXXXXX")
socket="$directory/tmux.sock"
config="$directory/tmux.conf"

serves() {
    "$binary" -S "$1" display-message -p '#{pid}' >/dev/null 2>&1
}

# Stops the server on the socket, then waits for it to stop answering.
stop() {
    "$binary" -S "$1" kill-server || return 1
    attempts=0
    while serves "$1" && [ "$attempts" -lt 60 ]; do
        sleep 0.05
        attempts=$((attempts + 1))
    done
    ! serves "$1"
}

cleanup() {
    status=$?
    trap - 0 HUP INT TERM PIPE
    # A closed output must not end the cleanup, whose messages are the only thing left to write.
    trap '' PIPE
    set +e
    stuck=
    left=
    if [ -S "$socket" ] && serves "$socket" && ! stop "$socket"; then
        stuck="$stuck tmux.sock"
    fi
    # Every socket anywhere under either directory, without following links. Only one a server answers
    # on is a leak; the runner's own is expected to be there.
    old_ifs=$IFS
    IFS='
'
    set -f
    for candidate in $(find "$tmpdir" "$directory" -type s 2>/dev/null); do
        [ "$candidate" = "$socket" ] && continue
        serves "$candidate" || continue
        case "$candidate" in
            "$tmpdir"/*) name=${candidate#"$tmpdir"/} ;;
            *) name=${candidate#"$directory"/} ;;
        esac
        left="$left $name"
        stop "$candidate" || stuck="$stuck $name"
    done
    set +f
    IFS=$old_ifs
    if [ -n "$stuck" ]; then
        printf 'tmux still answers on%s after kill-server; kept %s and %s under the runner root\n' \
            "$stuck" "${directory##*/}" "${tmpdir##*/}" >&2

        exit 1

    exit "$status"

(ns libtmux.examples.api.workspace
  "Build a layout, rename a window, and follow its new placement after a move."
  (:require [libtmux.core :as tm]
            [libtmux.data :as data]))

(defn -main [& args]
  (when-not (= 3 (count args))
    (throw (IllegalArgumentException. "expected: tmux-binary socket-path config-file")))
  (let [[binary socket config] args]
    (with-open [server (tm/open! {:binary binary :socket-path socket
                                 :config-file config})]
      (let [source (tm/new-session! server {:name "workspace" :window-name "editor"
                                           :command ["/bin/cat"]})
            editor (data/exactly-one (data/windows source))
            pane (data/exactly-one (data/panes editor))
            destination (tm/new-session! server {:name "destination" :command ["/bin/cat"]})]
        (tm/new-window! (:tmux/ref source) {:name "logs" :detached? true :command ["/bin/cat"]})
        (tm/split-pane! (:tmux/ref pane) {:direction :right :percent 40 :command ["/bin/cat"]})
        (let [layout (:window/layout (tm/refresh! (:tmux/ref editor)))]
          (tm/apply-layout! (:tmux/ref editor) layout))
        (let [renamed (tm/rename! (:tmux/ref editor) "code")]
          (assert (= "editor" (:window/name editor)))
          (assert (= "code" (:window/name renamed)))
          (tm/move-window! (:tmux/ref renamed) (:tmux/ref destination) 5))
        (let [moved (data/exactly-one
                     (filter #(= (:window/id editor) (:window/id %)) (tm/windows! server)))]
          (assert (data/same-entity? editor moved))
          (assert (not (data/same-link? editor moved)))
          (assert (= (:session/id destination) (get-in moved [:tmux/link :session/id])))
          (assert (= 5 (:window/index moved)))
          (assert (= 2 (count (data/panes moved))))
          (println (str "window=" (:window/name moved) " panes=" (count (data/panes moved))))
          (println "same-entity=true same-placement=false"))))))

(ns libtmux.examples.api.query
  "Compare a native predicate and Java expression on the same captured values."
  (:require [clojure.string :as str]

(ns libtmux.examples.api.watch-pane-output
  "Observe bounded UTF-8 output on an owned virtual worker, then close locally."
  (:require [clojure.string :as str]
            [libtmux.async :as async]
            [libtmux.control :as control]
            [libtmux.core :as tm]
            [libtmux.data :as data])
  (:import [java.lang AutoCloseable]
           [java.time Duration]))

(defn -main [& args]
  (when-not (= 3 (count args))
    (throw (IllegalArgumentException. "expected: tmux-binary socket-path config-file")))
  (let [[binary socket config] args]
    (with-open [server (tm/open! {:binary binary :socket-path socket :config-file config})]
      (let [session (tm/new-session! server {:name "stream-example" :command ["/bin/sh"]})
            pane (data/exactly-one (data/panes session))
            marker "stream-ready"]
        (try
          (with-open [^AutoCloseable runtime (async/runtime! {:max-running 2 :queue-limit 2})
                      ^AutoCloseable connection (control/attach! (:tmux/ref session) (Duration/ofMillis 900))
                      ;; One terminal line can arrive as many separate output events.
                      ^AutoCloseable stream (control/subscribe! connection
                                                               {:encoding :utf-8 :max-bytes 8192})]
            (let [observed
                  (async/submit! runtime {:kind :wait :timeout-ms 900}
                                 #(loop [suffix ""]
                                    (let [step (control/next! stream)]
                                      (when-not (= :event (:stream/status step))
                                        (throw (ex-info "Observation lost output or ended" step)))
                                      (if (= (:pane/id pane) (:pane/id step))
                                        (let [text (str suffix (:output/text step))]
                                          (if (str/includes? text marker)
                                            marker
                                            (recur (subs text (max 0 (- (count text) (dec (count marker))))))))
                                        (recur suffix)))))]
              (tm/send-literal! (:tmux/ref pane) "printf 'stream-%s\\n' ready")
              (tm/send-keys! (:tmux/ref pane) ["Enter"])
              (assert (= marker @observed))
              (control/close! stream)
              (let [ended (control/next! stream Duration/ZERO)]
                (assert (= :terminal (:stream/status ended)))
                (assert (= :closed (:reason (control/terminal stream)))))
              (println (str "observed=" marker))
              (println "closed=true")))
          (catch clojure.lang.ExceptionInfo failure

    (throw (IllegalArgumentException. "expected: tmux-binary socket-path config-file")))

    (with-open [server (tm/open! {:binary binary :socket-path socket :config-file config})]
      (let [session (tm/new-session! server {:name "stream-example" :command ["/bin/sh"]})

                      ^AutoCloseable connection (control/attach! (:tmux/ref session) (Duration/ofMillis 900))

(ns libtmux.examples.api.observe-with-async
  "Read bounded core.async events and close the consumer before draining."
  (:require [clojure.core.async :as channel]
            [clojure.string :as str]
            [libtmux.control :as control]
            [libtmux.core :as tm]
            [libtmux.core-async :as adapter]
            [libtmux.data :as data])
  (:import [java.lang AutoCloseable]
           [java.time Duration]))

(defn -main [& args]
  (when-not (= 3 (count args))
    (throw (IllegalArgumentException. "expected: tmux-binary socket-path config-file")))
  (let [[binary socket config] args]
    (with-open [server (tm/open! {:binary binary :socket-path socket :config-file config})]
      (let [session (tm/new-session! server {:name "async-example" :command ["/bin/sh"]})
            pane (data/exactly-one (data/panes session))
            marker "channel-ready"]
        (try
          (with-open [^AutoCloseable connection (control/attach! (:tmux/ref session) (Duration/ofMillis 900))]
            ;; Retain the default upstream bound for fragmented terminal output.
            (with-open [^AutoCloseable owner (adapter/observe! connection
                                                              {:event-capacity 1 :encoding :utf-8})]
              (let [deadline (channel/timeout 900)]
                (tm/send-literal! (:tmux/ref pane) "printf 'channel-%s\\n' ready")
                (tm/send-keys! (:tmux/ref pane) ["Enter"])
                (loop [suffix ""]
                  (let [[step port] (channel/alts!! [(adapter/events owner) deadline] :priority true)]
                    (when (or (identical? port deadline) (not= :event (:stream/status step)))
                      (throw (ex-info "Channel observation timed out, lost output or ended" {:step step})))
                    (let [text (if (= (:pane/id pane) (:pane/id step))
                                 (str suffix (:output/text step)) suffix)]
                      (when-not (str/includes? text marker)
                        (recur (subs text (max 0 (- (count text) (dec (count marker)))))))))))
              (channel/close! (adapter/events owner))
              (let [terminal-channel (adapter/terminal owner)
                    [outcome port] (channel/alts!! [terminal-channel (channel/timeout 900)] :priority true)]
                (assert (identical? terminal-channel port))
                (assert (= :adapter-stopped (:reason outcome)))))
            (assert (= :complete (:reply/status
                                 (control/send! connection ["display-message" "-p" "#{session_name}"]))))
            (println (str "observed=" marker))
            (println "adapter-stopped=true borrowed-open=true"))
          (catch clojure.lang.ExceptionInfo failure
            (if (= :tmux/unsupported-feature (:tmux/error (ex-data failure)))
              (do
                (assert (= :not-dispatched (:tmux/dispatch (ex-data failure))))
                (assert (empty? (tm/clients! server)))
                (println "requires tmux 3.7+"))
              (throw failure))))))))

#!/bin/sh
set -eu

if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then
    printf 'Usage: sh run.sh program [arguments...]\n' >&2
    exit 2
fi
binary=$(command -v "${TMUX_BIN:-tmux}")
root=${API_RUN_ROOT:-/tmp/libtmux-java-dev}

# A client that names no socket follows TMUX or LIBTMUX_SOCKET*, and otherwise lands on the default
# socket under TMUX_TMPDIR. The program gets none of them, and a TMUX_TMPDIR of its own below.
unset TMUX TMUX_PANE
for name in $(env | sed -n 's/^\(LIBTMUX_SOCKET[A-Za-z0-9_]*\)=.*/\1/p'); do
    unset "$name"
done

mkdir -p "$root"
directory=$(mktemp -d "$root/api.XXXXXX")
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d "$root/tmpdir.XXXXXX")
socket="$directory/tmux.sock"
config="$directory/tmux.conf"

serves() {
    "$binary" -S "$1" display-message -p '#{pid}' >/dev/null 2>&1
}

# Stops the server on the socket, then waits for it to stop answering.
stop() {
    "$binary" -S "$1" kill-server || return 1
    attempts=0
    while serves "$1" && [ "$attempts" -lt 60 ]; do
        sleep 0.05
        attempts=$((attempts + 1))
    done
    ! serves "$1"
}

cleanup() {
    status=$?
    trap - 0 HUP INT TERM PIPE
    # A closed output must not end the cleanup, whose messages are the only thing left to write.
    trap '' PIPE
    set +e
    stuck=
    left=
    if [ -S "$socket" ] && serves "$socket" && ! stop "$socket"; then
        stuck="$stuck tmux.sock"
    fi
    # Every socket anywhere under either directory, without following links. Only one a server answers
    # on is a leak; the runner's own is expected to be there.
    old_ifs=$IFS
    IFS='
'
    set -f
    for candidate in $(find "$tmpdir" "$directory" -type s 2>/dev/null); do
        [ "$candidate" = "$socket" ] && continue
        serves "$candidate" || continue
        case "$candidate" in
            "$tmpdir"/*) name=${candidate#"$tmpdir"/} ;;
            *) name=${candidate#"$directory"/} ;;
        esac
        left="$left $name"
        stop "$candidate" || stuck="$stuck $name"
    done
    set +f
    IFS=$old_ifs
    if [ -n "$stuck" ]; then
        printf 'tmux still answers on%s after kill-server; kept %s and %s under the runner root\n' \
            "$stuck" "${directory##*/}" "${tmpdir##*/}" >&2
        exit 1

    if [ -n "$left" ]; then
        printf 'The program left a tmux server running:%s\n' "$left" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    exit "$status"

    exit 1

(ns libtmux.examples.api.observe-with-async
  "Read bounded core.async events and close the consumer before draining."
  (:require [clojure.core.async :as channel]
            [clojure.string :as str]
            [libtmux.control :as control]
            [libtmux.core :as tm]
            [libtmux.core-async :as adapter]
            [libtmux.data :as data])
  (:import [java.lang AutoCloseable]
           [java.time Duration]))

(defn -main [& args]
  (when-not (= 3 (count args))
    (throw (IllegalArgumentException. "expected: tmux-binary socket-path config-file")))
  (let [[binary socket config] args]
    (with-open [server (tm/open! {:binary binary :socket-path socket :config-file config})]
      (let [session (tm/new-session! server {:name "async-example" :command ["/bin/sh"]})
            pane (data/exactly-one (data/panes session))
            marker "channel-ready"]
        (try
          (with-open [^AutoCloseable connection (control/attach! (:tmux/ref session) (Duration/ofMillis 900))]
            ;; Retain the default upstream bound for fragmented terminal output.
            (with-open [^AutoCloseable owner (adapter/observe! connection
                                                              {:event-capacity 1 :encoding :utf-8})]
              (let [deadline (channel/timeout 900)]
                (tm/send-literal! (:tmux/ref pane) "printf 'channel-%s\\n' ready")
                (tm/send-keys! (:tmux/ref pane) ["Enter"])
                (loop [suffix ""]
                  (let [[step port] (channel/alts!! [(adapter/events owner) deadline] :priority true)]
                    (when (or (identical? port deadline) (not= :event (:stream/status step)))
                      (throw (ex-info "Channel observation timed out, lost output or ended" {:step step})))
                    (let [text (if (= (:pane/id pane) (:pane/id step))
                                 (str suffix (:output/text step)) suffix)]
                      (when-not (str/includes? text marker)
                        (recur (subs text (max 0 (- (count text) (dec (count marker)))))))))))
              (channel/close! (adapter/events owner))
              (let [terminal-channel (adapter/terminal owner)
                    [outcome port] (channel/alts!! [terminal-channel (channel/timeout 900)] :priority true)]
                (assert (identical? terminal-channel port))
                (assert (= :adapter-stopped (:reason outcome)))))
            (assert (= :complete (:reply/status
                                 (control/send! connection ["display-message" "-p" "#{session_name}"]))))
            (println (str "observed=" marker))
            (println "adapter-stopped=true borrowed-open=true"))
          (catch clojure.lang.ExceptionInfo failure
            (if (= :tmux/unsupported-feature (:tmux/error (ex-data failure)))
              (do
                (assert (= :not-dispatched (:tmux/dispatch (ex-data failure))))
                (assert (empty? (tm/clients! server)))
                (println "requires tmux 3.7+"))
              (throw failure))))))))
